Name: Appleseed's Extra Forage And Fermentation
Author: TheAppleSauceIsStale
Description:
[left][size=3]Originally part of a larger project, Extra Foraging And Fermentation is a small expansion to forestry, berry-picking, preserving and cooking. Discover a few new wild resources, grow your own yeast grains, and use them to brew new drinks and make new treats!

The mod that this content was cut from is still in progress, which means that certain details of this one will inevitably be subject to change! Expect[b] recipe tweaks, changes to how recipes are learned, and possibly changed items [/b]in this mod[b] [/b]when the full expansion is released, but neither mod will be required for the other to function.[/size]

[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]

Lookup Anything[/url]﻿ is highly recommended to see machine processing rules and cooking recipes at any time! 

While this mod's general price balancing uses vanilla prices as a base, the selling price of cooking recipes follows the formula of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32757]Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul - Continued[/url]﻿ -- the combined value of base quality ingredients + about 10%.

[size=3][b][color=#e69138]Enable Fermentation Crock[/color] [/b](Default True): Adds the Fermentation Crock machine as an alternative way to process all of this mod's artisan goods (besides Checkerberry Oil.) If enabled, vanilla machines will no longer be used to make them.

[b][color=#e69138]Fermentation Crock Recipe[/color] [/b](Default Default): Lets you pick between knowing how to craft Fermentation Crocks by default, or needing to be sent the recipe by Leah after gaining 3 hearts with her.

[color=#e69138][b]Leaf Color[/b][/color] (Default Green):[b] [/b]Toggles the colors of leaves on item sprites between green and blue, useful when using certain environment and foliage retextures.

[b][color=#e69138]Perfection [/color][color=#e69138]Tracking[/color] [/b](Default On):[b] [/b]Lets you decide if shipping new items should count towards perfection.

[color=#e69138][b]Randomized Sourdough[/b] [/color](Default True): Switches the sourdough recipe between five random variants each day.

[color=#e69138][b]Prunes Sprite[/b][/color] (Default Default): Choose between vanilla-style prunes or the default sprite.

[color=#e69138][b]Item Toggles[/b] [/color](Default All Enabled): Lets you enable or disable most artisan goods and recipes.[/size]



[size=3]  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿  ﻿[img]https://imgur.com/BAoWkMS.png[/img]﻿[/size]


[size=3][b][color=#e69138]- - - Cornucopia - - -[/color][/b]

Certain cooking recipes and artisan goods are altered to use Cornucopia items and subsequently increase in price if [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]﻿, ﻿[url=http://][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Cornucopia - Artisan Machines[/url]﻿, or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39057]Cornucopia - Cooking Recipes[/url]﻿ are also installed.

﻿﻿⚠ The machine rules for Tea Eggs overwrite Cornucopia's pickled eggs when the Fermentation Crock is not enabled -- [u]trying to make pickled eggs with three or more [/u][u]eggs in your hand will currently not work manually, but should still work if using mods like Automate or Junimatic. [/u][/size]
